sn12.32:8.2: ‘But Reverend Sāriputta, how have you known and seen so that you’ve declared enlightenment:
sn12.32:8.3: “I understand: ‘Rebirth is ended, the spiritual journey has been completed, what had to be done has been done, there is nothing further for this place.’”’
sn12.32:9.5: ‘But what is the source, origin, birthplace, and inception of rebirth?’
sn12.32:10.5: ‘What is the source of continued existence?’
sn12.32:14.6: ‘But Reverend, how have you been liberated that you declare enlightenment:
sn12.32:14.7: “I understand: ‘Rebirth is ended, the spiritual journey has been completed, what had to be done has been done, there is nothing further for this place.’”’
sn12.32:16.8: I could answer for two days and nights …
sn12.32:16.10: I could answer for three days and nights …
sn12.32:16.12: I could answer for four days and nights …
sn12.32:16.14: I could answer for five days and nights …
sn12.32:16.16: I could answer for six days and nights …
sn12.32:17.4: But when the Buddha agreed with my answer, I thought:
sn12.32:17.5: If the Buddha were to question me all day on this matter in different words and ways, I could answer all day with different words and ways;
sn12.32:17.7: If the Buddha were to question me all day and night …
sn12.32:17.8: If the Buddha were to question me for two days and nights …
sn12.32:17.13: or seven days and nights, I could answer in different words and ways for seven days and nights.”
sn12.32:18.2: If I were to question Sāriputta all night on this matter in different words and ways, Sāriputta could answer me all night …
sn12.32:18.3: If I were to question Sāriputta on this matter all day and night, Sāriputta could answer me on this matter all day and night …
sn12.32:18.4: If I were to question Sāriputta on this matter for two days and nights, Sāriputta could answer me on this matter for two days and nights …
sn12.32:18.5: If I were to question Sāriputta on this matter for three days and nights, Sāriputta could answer me on this matter for three days and nights …
sn12.32:18.6: If I were to question Sāriputta on this matter for four days and nights, Sāriputta could answer me on this matter for four days and nights …
sn12.32:18.7: If I were to question Sāriputta on this matter for five days and nights, Sāriputta could answer me on this matter for five days and nights …
sn12.32:18.8: If I were to question Sāriputta on this matter for six days and nights, Sāriputta could answer me on this matter for six days and nights …
sn12.32:18.9: If I were to question Sāriputta on this matter for seven days and nights in different words and ways, Sāriputta could answer me on this matter for seven days and nights in different words and ways.”
